body_excerpt:
It was discovered that python-cryptography incorrectly accepted objects
with immutable buffers when performing certain cipher operations. This
would result in corrupted output, contrary to expectations. This issue only
affected Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2023-23931)

It was discovered that python-cryptography reported the outcome of
decrypting PKCS#7 enveloped data in distinguishable ways, and with
observable timing differences. A remote attacker could possibly use this
issue to recover the key used to encrypt the message contents, and obtain
sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-69247)

Jack Lloyd discovered that python-cryptography incorrectly handled wildcard
DNS names when enforcing the name constraints of a certificate authority. A
remote attacker could possibly use this issue to have an invalid
certificate chain accepted, and use names outside of the permitted ones.
This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-69248)

Samuel Judson discovered that python-cryptography incorrectly handled
certificate chains that contained duplicate certificates. A remote attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause python-cryptography to use excessive
resources, leading to a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu
26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-69249)
